mechanism: Enoxaparin and potassium supplements can both increase serum potassium levels through inhibition of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system and aldosterone-mediated potassium excretion, increasing hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; assess renal function and consider dose adjustments or alternative potassium supplementation methods; educate patients on dietary potassium restriction if on both agents.
